page.notes: Left edge of the scan cuts off the first letters of several lines; the leading "um" and "ivis" fragments are kept as printed, and "c[?]ivis" is a guess. "tebuerit"/"debuerit" and "Prætheuram" (should probably read Præturam) are doubtful readings. "Praetura"/"Prætura" differ in the printed text; the pulled letters are as seen. Small reference marks in the right margin (around the first line and near the middle) carry no printed text and were not transcribed. The page ends mid-word ("ali-"), continuing on the next page.
